issues.description: The Farm methods for singing have inconsistent return types across artifacts: the problem statement UML specifies singFarmSong(): void and singFarmSongVerse(animal: Animal): void (i.e., the song should be printed), the template declares public void singFarmSong() and a private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/) that print directly, but the solution implements private String singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) and public String singFarmSong() returning the song text. This mismatch between void (print) and String (return) will confuse students about the expected signature and behavior and may cause test or integration issues.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signatures consistent across artifacts. Either (A) change the solution to match the UML/template by making singFarmSong() and singFarmSongVerse(Animal) return void and print the song directly, or (B) update the problem statement and template to specify and use String return types (and document that the returned String is printed by callers). Prefer option A to preserve the UML expectation that the song is printed.

issues.description: The Farm singing methods are inconsistent across artifacts: the Problem Statement and Template define/expect singFarmSong() (and the helper singFarmSongVerse) to print the song (void behavior), whereas the Solution Repository implements singFarmSong() and singFarmSongVerse(...) to return Strings. This mismatch in method contract (void/printing vs. returning String) creates a mapping confusion for students about whether they should implement printing side-effects or return the song text.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the method contracts across all artifacts. Either: (A) change the Solution to match the Problem/Template by making singFarmSong() and singFarmSongVerse(Animal) return void and perform printing (System.out.println) as specified in the problem; or (B) update the Problem statement and Template to require singFarmSong() to return a String (and singFarmSongVerse to return String) and document that the returned String contains the full song, then adjust template signatures accordingly. Preferred: implement option (A) so the Solution prints directly and matches the stated learning task (printing the song).
